steps.title: Order oligonucleotide primers
steps.instruction: Order the following oligos (RNA or DNA as indicated) for the IgG sequencing workflow:

substeps.instruction: TS pF (RNA): AAGCAGTGGTATCAACGCAGAGTACATrGrGrG
TS pFAAGCAGTGGTATCAACGCAGAGTACATrGrGrG (universal)
IGHG RT pR (10 µM): GACAGGGCTCCAGAGTTCC
IGHG PCR pR (10 µM): GACTGGCTCAGGGAAATAGCC
IGKC RT pR (10 µM): CTGATCAGTAACACTGTCCAGGAC
IGKC PCR pR (10 µM): ACTGATGTCTCTGGGATAGAAGTTG
IGLC1 RT pR (10 µM): GGGAGATAGGTGCACCATTTGC
IGLC1 PCR pR (10 µM): GCCACTTCCACATCACTCG
IGLC2 RT pR (10 µM): CCACACCCTGAGTGATAGGG
IGLC2 PCR pR (10 µM): TTCCAGACCACTGTCATAACACC

steps.title: Extract total RNA
steps.instruction: Isolate RNA from the hybridoma cells using the RNeasy Total RNA Kit, following the manufacturer’s protocol.

steps.title: Prepare first RT mix
steps.instruction: On ice, assemble a 4 µL reverse‑transcription reaction for each chain type in PCR tubes:

substeps.instruction: Gamma chain: 1 µL IGHG RT pR (10 µM) + 1 µL dNTP (10 mM) + 2 µL RNA sample (50 ng/µL) → total 4 µL.
Kappa chain: 1 µL IGKC RT pR (10 µM) + 1 µL dNTP (10 mM) + 2 µL RNA sample (50 ng/µL) → total 4 µL.
Lambda chain (use only if Kappa fails): 1 µL IGLC1 (or IGLC2) RT pR (10 µM) + 1 µL dNTP (10 mM) + 2 µL RNA sample (50 ng/µL) → total 4 µL.

steps.title: Prepare second SMARTScribe mix
steps.instruction: On ice, make a 5 µL second‑reaction master mix (scale up as needed): 2 µL 5× SMARTScribe buffer, 1 µL DTT (20 mM), 0.3 µL Universal TS pR (100 µM), 1.70 µL nuclease‑free H₂O (total 5.00 µL).

steps.title: Add enzymes to second mix
steps.instruction: While the first‑reaction incubation proceeds, add to each 5 µL second‑reaction mix: 0.50 µL RNase inhibitor (40 U/µL) and 0.50 µL SMARTScribe Reverse Transcriptase (100 U/µL), bringing the volume to 1.00 µL.

steps.title: Combine first and second RT mixes
steps.instruction: After the 1st‑reaction incubation finishes, add 6 µL of the prepared 2nd‑reaction mix to each 1st‑reaction tube.

substeps.instruction: 42 °C for 60 min
170 °C for 5 min
Hold at 14 °C (or until samples reach a 4 °C hold) and proceed immediately to PCR.

steps.title: Prepare PCR master mix
steps.instruction: For each chain type, assemble a 50 µL PCR reaction:

substeps.instruction: Gamma chain: 25 µL Platinum SuperFi II PCR Master Mix, 2.5 µL ISPCR pF (10 µM), 2.5 µL IGHG PCR pR (10 µM), 3 µL cDNA (5–100 ng), 17 µL nuclease‑free water.
Kappa chain: 25 µL Platinum SuperFi II PCR Master Mix, 2.5 µL ISPCR pF (10 µM), 2.5 µL IGKC PCR pR (10 µM), 3 µL cDNA (5–100 ng), 17 µL nuclease‑free water.
Lambda chain (if Kappa fails): 25 µL Platinum SuperFi II PCR Master Mix, 2.5 µL ISPCR pF (10 µM), 2.5 µL IGLC1 (or IGLC2) PCR pR (10 µM), 3 µL cDNA (5–100 ng), 17 µL nuclease‑free water.

steps.title: Run PCR amplification
steps.instruction: Perform PCR using the prepared master mixes with the appropriate cycling conditions supplied by the Platinum SuperFi II kit (not detailed in the source).

steps.title: Verify PCR products by gel
steps.instruction: Analyze PCR amplicons on a 1 % agarose gel:

substeps.instruction: Prepare gel: dissolve 0.5 g agarose in 50 mL 1× TAE buffer, microwave ~1 min until clear.
Add 5 µL SYBR Safe to the cooled agarose solution, swirl, and pour into a casting tray with a comb suitable for 20 µL wells.
Mix each PCR sample: 5 µL PCR product + 1 µL DNA loading dye; load into wells.
Run gel for 25–30 min at 110 V, then image and save the gel.
Expected band size: 550–600 bp (gamma chain plus either kappa or lambda light chain).

steps.title: Submit samples for Sanger sequencing
steps.instruction: Send the verified PCR products to a sequencing service (e.g., GeneWiz or the institutional Genomic Core).

steps.title: Analyze sequences with IMGT
steps.instruction: Open https://www.imgt.org/IMGT_vquest/vquest, paste each nucleotide sequence into the “sequence submission” field, select species “Rattus norvegicus”, receptor type “IGH”, and click “Start”.
